reasoning: 驗證目標：在任何導致離開 360L 的系統事件發生時，系統無使用者可感知的延遲即完成轉換。為什麼這樣切：條款未給任何時間門檻（無數值、無「不大於」句），故 ER 不得自行編造秒數——編一個數字等於把未裁的驗收標準寫進交付物。可判準的替代形式是：以固定的 360L 操作組逐項觀察，並要求轉換在同一次使用者動作內完成、其間不出現中間畫面或空白畫面。門檻缺口已登錄 A-SX25 並入 RD-1（§8.4.1）。與 189 的差別：該 leaf 的觸發是使用者主動動作，本 leaf 是系統事件（§8.2.1）。條款自附的 NOTE 界定「離開」兼指畫面與音訊，故兩者皆為判準。

tcs.tc_title: System-initiated exit from 360L has no perceivable delay
tcs.test_item: Upon any system event that causes exit from the 360L function, the system shall transition out of the 360L function without user-perceivable delay, exit meaning transition away from any part of the 360L HMI and suspension of 360L audio as appropriate
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active 360L subscription
2. IP connectivity for 360L streaming is available
3. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
4. The 360L exercise set is defined and fixed for this test: enter 360L, browse the channel list, open For You, start an On Demand episode, return to live, change channel twice, open Settings and exit 360L
5. An incoming call can be raised while the 360L function is in use
6. The session is recorded so that the display and audio can be reviewed frame by frame
tcs.test_procedure:
1. With 360L in use and its audio playing, raise an incoming call and record the display and audio
2. Review the recording from the call arriving to the 360L HMI being left and 360L audio being suspended
3. Repeat the incoming call three times and review each recording
4. Compare the three exits
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU leaves the 360L function when the call arrives
2. The 360L HMI is left and the 360L audio is suspended without an intervening blank screen, wait indication or continued 360L audio over the call
3. Each of the three exits shows the same behaviour
4. No exit takes noticeably longer than the others
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
